C0426.title: QR Code Phishing Study: An Empirical Investigation of Phishing Attacks via QR Codes
C0426.summary: Researchers conducted a real-world QR code phishing campaign on a research campus, testing two distinct QR code variants to assess whether leveraging QR codes is a viable attack vector for phishing.

references.title: Hooked: A Real-World Study on QR Code Phishing - arXiv.org
